text: McTaggart called the bare, directionless ordering of positions -- one that lacks both the earlier/later direction of the B-series and the changing past/present/future properties of the A-series -- the ___ series.
explanation: The expected answer is 'C'. The C-series is McTaggart's bare ordering with no temporal direction and no A-properties; he regarded it as the atemporal reality underlying the mere appearance of time. It is not the A-series (which adds past/present/future) nor the B-series (which adds earlier/later direction).
